the regulation of ABA in the fruit ripen and dehydration stress in pear 'Gold Niijisseiki'.
the transcriptional regulation of ABA metabolism enzymes involved in the fruit ripeness and dehydration stress of 'Gold Nijiseeiki'.
the transcriptional regulation of genes involved in ABA metabolism during fruit development and dehydration of pear.

ABA may play a role in the fruit development of pear by regulating sugar metabolism and chlorophyll degradation, and in the fruit ripenning and dehydration by regulating ethylene synthesis and degradation.

the expression of PpNCESD1 and PpACED2 in the pulp and peel was positively correlated with the increase of the ABA level, which suggests that the expression of these two genes may be the main factors in controlling ABA level in the fruit of 'Gold Nijisseei' and the expression of PNCED1 and NCED2 was upregulated by ABA.
